recognize_zh: 紅色膜染色標示出許多散在、部分成小群的大型陽性細胞，細胞邊界清楚呈環狀，而周圍絕大多數小淋巴球為陰性；大型 B 細胞散佈在以非 B 細胞為主的背景中，符合 NLPHL 變異型態的 LP 細胞分佈。
features: Numerous scattered large cells with crisp circumferential membranous red staining
Positive large cells occur singly and in small loose clusters
Background small lymphocytes largely negative, with only rare small positive cells
Positive cells distributed diffusely across the field without a compact B-cell nodule
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen; antigen not labeled, membranous pattern suggests a B-cell marker such as CD20) shows numerous large positive cells distributed singly and in small loose clusters within a background of predominantly negative small lymphocytes. Compact nodules of small positive B cells are not evident in this field. The pattern of scattered large B cells in a small-lymphocyte background lacking small B cells is consistent with a T-cell-rich variant pattern of nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma, which should be distinguished from T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma by architectural stains.

ddx.vs: THRLBCL lacks residual small B cells and CD21+ FDC meshworks throughout the specimen; any preserved B-cell-rich nodule favors NLPHL.
HRS cells are typically CD20 weak or negative and CD30/CD15 positive, unlike these strongly membranous-positive large cells.
Reactive immunoblasts show a range of sizes, plasmacytoid maturation, and polytypic light chains rather than monotonous LP-cell atypia.
